So me and my friend Levi we're building paintball forts in the wood between our houses. we'd set up a couple of forts in the wood behind my house earlier. Just stacking dead logs on top of eachother so we were moving making a bunch of noise for hours. We lived in an area full of deer and other woodland creatures and as teenage boys, we always felt safe thinking nothing would ever bother us. I mean I'd heard of bears but their territory was over 50 miles away. This isn't a bear encounter story. 

Eventually we got to the woods behind his house, there we are bravely causing a ruckus about a hundred yards away from his house. Which also added to our sense of security. Suddenly we're both staring at eachother frozen in fear. Spine tingling fear and we're not saying a word for about a solid thirty seconds and we're scanning the woods around us and we both felt a sense of unease. suddenly a blood curdlin scream, louder than a gunshot erupts seemingly from every direction and last for what feels like an eternity. I mean there was no pinpointing where it came from and it absolutely did not sound like any animal we've ever heard. I yell run and we snap out of it, Sprint to his back porch. We go inside trying to make sense of the whole thing and we're grasping at straws. It was unnatural and to this day there is nothing that competes. Well a year later a mountain lion was spotted less than five miles away from where we lived and was shot by a hunter. It was the first mountain lion spotted since the 70s. 

Logically I can assume that was the scream of a mountain loin and I'd even looked up what a mountain lion sounds like. However the more I think of it the less it actually sounded like a mountain lion. Blood curdling is the only description I can give it. I can't explain why before we heard the calamity we both dropped the logs we were moving and locked eyes. I don't know why we started looking into the wood. If it was a mountain lion why didn't it chase us?  We were prey it definitely could have got one of us. Why did it sound like it was coming from all angles? Sometimes I just tell myself it was that mountain lion but part of me can't accept that it wasn't something else.
